finding.evidence: The scheduled workflows succeeded once at 2026-09-23 01:32-01:33 UTC, then no capture was queued or running at the check. Configured 01:37, 01:52 and 02:07 UTC capture slots were not enqueued. Repository and public manifests matched and Pages was successful.
finding.cause: GitHub scheduled workflow invocations were not enqueued for the later slots. Repository evidence does not expose GitHub's upstream scheduler cause.

action.method: Appended one UTC maintenance-trigger comment to .github/workflows/capture-bellbrook-camera.yml using freshly read blob SHA 2478a1e7eec9f5f72c6db80495d7c04a596ea40b. Functional content remained unchanged. Workflow dispatch was not exposed by connected GitHub tools.

limitations: The repository proves missed enqueue times but does not expose GitHub's upstream scheduler cause.
Embedded camera timestamps were read from image overlays and treated as AEST.
No archived frames were deleted, deduplicated, overwritten, pruned or shortened.
